title: AgentAI-Hub — Interactive AI Agents Platform
description: Production platform and interactive directory curated for autonomous AI agents, tool integration pipelines, and intelligent workflows. Built with modern TypeScript and deployed live.
longDescription: Engineered with Next.js and TypeScript. Features agent categorization, architecture blueprints, benchmarking benchmarks, and real-time community agent discovery.

title: Physics-Based RAG with Small Language Models
description: Domain-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation system coupled with Small Language Models (SLMs) for rapid, accurate physical sciences reasoning and equation-aware retrieval.
longDescription: Incorporates custom vector indexing with physics-aware chunking, LaTeX formula preservation, and fine-tuned SLMs for edge-capable real-time question answering.

title: AI Industrial Safety Intelligence (Zero-Harm)
description: Computer vision & hazard detection platform for zero-harm industrial operations. Real-time PPE compliance, zone violation monitoring, and automated incident triage.
longDescription: Processes multi-camera RTSP video streams with low-latency edge inference. Automatically alerts safety managers upon detecting safety violations or hazardous worker proximities.

title: AI Road Safety Intelligence System
description: Full-stack platform automating road safety audit analysis. NLP extraction, IRC clause mapping via TF-IDF, SOR/CPWD/GeM cost estimation, RAG-based AI chatbot. 🥈 2nd Place Nationally at IIT Madras CoERS 2025.
longDescription: Won 2nd place nationally in a ₹90K prize pool organized by IIT Madras' MoRTH-funded Centre of Excellence for Road Safety. Built with a 4-person team in 36 hours.

title: Advanced Face Biometric & Emotion System
description: Enterprise-grade real-time biometric platform featuring face recognition, 7-class emotion analysis, anti-spoofing liveness detection, and full audit logging. Consent-first architecture.
longDescription: Built to production-grade standards with enterprise security principles. The system supports multi-user enrollment, role-based access, and real-time monitoring dashboards.

title: CausalGuard & Women Safety Analytics
description: Dual-module platform uniting intelligent safety companion features with spatial crime hotspot risk modeling, causal inference, and dynamic emergency routing.
longDescription: Combines a TypeScript web companion with Python analytics that analyze spatial datasets, ambient lighting scores, and nearest police station proximity to compute safe transit routes.

title: Hand Gesture & ISL Recognition
description: L4 enterprise-grade platform combining custom hand gesture recognition with Indian Sign Language detection. 2,500+ lines across 10 modular components with Singleton, Factory, and Observer patterns.
longDescription: Designed with accessibility as the core mission. Supports real-time ISL translation with 90%+ recognition accuracy across 26 alphabets and 100+ common phrases.

title: Continual Learning Engine (HAT & EWC)
description: Research repository combating catastrophic forgetting in deep networks. Implementation of Hard Attention to Task (HAT), Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), and episodic replay.
longDescription: Benchmarked on Split-CIFAR-100 across 5 sequential task splits. Evaluates Backward Transfer (BWT) and Forward Transfer (FWT) metrics using custom PyTorch modules.

title: RishiCherry Interactive Web Experience
description: Dynamic, responsive interactive web canvas experience featuring creative animations, visual styling, and sound/interaction effects deployed live on GitHub Pages.
longDescription: Showcases frontend creativity, smooth keyframe styling, and responsive layout architecture.

title: Chemical Buddy — AI Study Assistant
description: AI chemistry study assistant with PDF document analysis, natural language Q&A, and unit conversion. Built on LangChain, FAISS vector search, and Google Generative AI.
longDescription: 10th place at InnovateK12 Hackathon. Supports any chemistry PDF as a knowledge base with semantic search powered by FAISS.

title: Shakti — AI Educational Chatbot
description: Multilingual AI chatbot supporting 10 languages with dual text/voice interaction. Covers Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Math with dynamic quizzes and personalized roadmaps.
longDescription: Powered by NLP and speech recognition for voice input/output. Designed for students in rural India who speak regional languages.

title: HappyRakhi Celebration Experience
description: Interactive festive web application with particle physics, personalized greeting generator, and dynamic festival sound effects.
longDescription: Interactive cultural project blending modern CSS animations with interactive particle celebration triggers.

title: Trade Insights Bot — Ultimate Edition
description: Multi-agent AI trading assistant with real-time insights, portfolio analytics (Sharpe, Volatility, Drawdown), news sentiment via DuckDuckGo, and LLM-powered strategy backtesting.
longDescription: Side-by-side strategy comparison with live charting. Supports paper trading simulation and strategy scoring.

title: AI Coding Assistant — VS Code Extension
description: VS Code extension delivering AI-powered real-time code autocompletion and natural language code summarization via Gemini API integrated into developer workflows.
longDescription: Available as a .vsix package. Provides context-aware completions that understand the entire file, not just the current line.
